sql:
with tenant as (
  select id as tenant_id
  from tenants
  where name = 'Cragsley Outfitters'
),
cart_weeks as (
  select
    c.id,
    c.status,
    c.created_at,
    c.converted_at,
    cd.week_start
  from carts c
  join tenant t on c.tenant_id = t.tenant_id
  join calendar_days cd on cd.calendar_date = c.created_at::date
  where cd.week_start >= date '2025-10-06'
    and cd.week_start <= date '2025-12-22'
)
select
  week_start,
  count(*) as carts_created,
  round(100.0 * sum(case when status = 'converted' then 1 else 0 end) / count(*), 1) as overall_conversion_pct,
  round(100.0 * sum(case when status = 'converted' and converted_at is not null
            and extract(epoch from (converted_at - created_at)) / 3600.0 <= 1
            then 1 else 0 end) / count(*), 1) as pct_converted_within_1_hour,
  round(100.0 * sum(case when status = 'converted' and converted_at is not null
            and extract(epoch from (converted_at - created_at)) / 3600.0 >= 24
            and extract(epoch from (converted_at - created_at)) / 3600.0 <= 168
            then 1 else 0 end) / count(*), 1) as pct_converted_1_to_7_days
from cart_weeks
group by week_start
order by week_start asc
